bench_prefilter_kernels.description: Separate prefilter microbenchmark inside bioseq_benchmark. One-time shared input preparation (dataset read, byte-rank flattening, jobs) and the untimed bundled-source/scalar/edit-distance oracles are reported separately. The measured backend_batch region is the complete selected batch API call; for Vulkan it includes upload, dispatch, synchronization, and result readback. callback_total additionally includes output materialization and separately reported runtime validation, while callback_non_backend is its difference from backend_batch. No per-row pseudo end-to-end number incorrectly adds the shared input setup. These <=250 bp fixtures use one complete maze (t=y=len), avoiding the source implementation's multi-maze tail quirks. CPU/source rows sweep E=2/8/40/100; Vulkan rows sweep only the kernel's evaluated E=2/8/16/31 domain. Every available row is validated after backend timing against source decisions and exact ED truth; available Vulkan rows additionally require status-0 execution and exact scalar lower-bound/status/decision parity. Vulkan-unavailable rows are nonblocking and never CPU-fallback. Reports 151/153/154 exposed the max_edits=2 SRR-E100 Vulkan P50 moving 0.410/0.512/0.694 ms with only three samples. All rows now retain 11 measured samples under the existing exclusive serial GPU schedule and fixed seeded interleaving; correctness and within-run performance gates are unchanged.

bench_prefilter_small_seeds.description: Blocking hardware-Vulkan comparison of GateKeeper and SneakySnake on deterministic 32/64-symbol prefixes. Each callback times a complete upload/dispatch/wait/readback batch, then requires full CPU-oracle parity, supported geometry, result-count parity, and zero false rejects. Every matched independent P50 GateKeeper cell must be more than 10% faster than SneakySnake.

bench_prefilter_pipeline.description: Controlled on/off regional-impact benchmark in the existing aligner harness. Every row uses TWO_STACK_NTHASH + bounded SIMD_MM2 + KSW2, computes exact edit distance, and exposes only matches with ED<=16. The varied dimension is prefilter off versus scalar/SIMD/Vulkan. E=16 lies inside the Vulkan kernel's evaluated E<=31 domain, so the GPU row must report evaluated maze jobs and zero status-2 jobs. Named-region output includes prefilter and mm_align_skeleton. Operation-originated stats report actual backend dispatches, status-classified jobs, rejected jobs/regions, survivors, KSW2 calls, and input-cell area; enabled rows fail closed unless stats are available and report non-empty work from the selected backend, while the off row requires stats to be absent. A shared zero-work evaluator ledger records framework-resolved off/Vulkan schedule provenance by threshold, requires an available Vulkan row to have a scheduled same-threshold off row, compares their actual timed match counts as soon as both repeat-zero rows have completed, rejects count changes across repetitions, and never replays either pipeline. Hardware-Vulkan absence reports required/performed/passed=0 without CPU fallback or a blocking comparison.

bench_aligners_grid.description: Length × error × algorithm matrix. Iteration counts are bucket-tuned (60 SHORT, 35 MEDIUM, 12 LONG, 3 VERY_LONG, 2 XL) so SHORT cells drive the tight noise floor while XL cells stay inside the per-call budget. Skip noisy×long cells (LONG / VERY_LONG / XL × ONT_HIGH_ERROR, HIGH_INDEL_LOW_SUB) — minimap2 itself fails to produce a primary at 8-10% indel rate on >50 kbp pairs.

bench_aligners_curated.description: Curated correctness probes. Exact eight-row/four-case acceptance and blocking all-sample biological bounds cover every unique-fragment, SEAL-style batch, FAST_LONG, and FAST_VERY_LONG observation. The resident GPU-index frontend FAST_LONG row must produce one match, primary correctness 1, and zero offset. Wall timing is diagnostic only: five concurrent groups share a process-wide Vulkan queue mutex, so wall samples include unequal queue waiting and independent row P50/P99 estimates are not acceptance-grade. Scheduling variance does not alter biological or index-construction acceptance. The 10M/100M targets are below the 256 Mi-bp source-direct threshold, so the named small-target sibling comparisons are not direct-resident stats. Blocking GPU speed acceptance lives in the serial, route-validated XXL relative and paired gates; a row-pruning filter remains a hard configuration error here, so no biological comparison side can disappear vacuously.

bench_aligners_xxl_hifi_relative.description: XXL_HIFI-only non-E2E algorithm comparison. Four samples and nine controlled rows apply independent within-run P50 wall/stage ceilings. The 500M target is above the 256 Mi-bp production threshold: strict execution receipts validate both the direct resident and resident GPU-index frontend routes, and a blocking same-report P50 rule requires route-validated resident GPU-index frontend to beat route-validated source-direct Vulkan. Batched-KSW2 wall is bounded at 1.005x; SIMD/scalar sketch and chaining are bounded at 0.214x and 0.600x. The mixed GPU/CPU Vulkan wall ceiling remains visible at 1.011221x only as a nonblocking diagnostic; it is not faster or all-GPU acceptance evidence. Every SIMD_MM2 row explicitly selects bounded_batch_approximate as a promotion candidate and must validate requested/observed policy identity, positive accelerated cutoff work, and zero scalar fallback. Every Vulkan-labelled row is a mixed GPU/CPU route (CPU work remains) and is explicitly ineligible for all-GPU acceptance.

bench_aligners_simd_chaining_endpoint_qu.description: Two-row absolute qualification gate. The real row owns all biological work: it runs bounded SIMD, exact SIMD, and bundled minimap2 sequentially on each fixed one-target fixture, requires one normalized primary from each backend, and includes a source-constructed prefix/repeat-bank/repeat-wall/suffix default-max-skip=25 fixture whose own stats must show cutoff, skipped candidates, and a winning global-best rescue across the repeated bank. Its endpoint participates in the same strict <15-bp maxima. The clearly labelled zero-reference row performs no biological work and exists only because framework rules compare rows rather than literals. Ordinary rules reject failures while preserving complete report and raw stats; wall time and endpoint maxima remain diagnostics. primary_correct_fraction is emitted as 1.0 by both rows only to satisfy the config-global cross-run regression metric contract and is not an endpoint acceptance signal.

bench_aligners_xxl_hifi_chain_focus.description: Three-row scalar/exact-SIMD/explicitly-bounded-SIMD iteration gate. Bounded forward and shared SIMD backtracking must beat scalar, execute real cutoff/skipped work, retain strict correctness, and validate zero scalar score/backtrack fallback. Exact remains a non-promotion oracle; rescue and exact-policy timing are retained as nonblocking diagnostics.

bench_aligners_xxl_hifi_paired.description: Statistically paired companion to bench_aligners_xxl_hifi_relative. It keeps the same nine rows and strict route/correctness validation, but runs one exclusive single-group batch for 11 seeded repetition-major repeats. It reports P50 repeat-wise ratios after retaining repeat zero as first-repeat stats and excluding it from the 10 steady-state pairs. The resident GPU-index frontend/source-direct ratio below 1 is blocking because both routes execute in this exact serial schedule with strict positive receipts; the report_76-derived 10% wall and 15% stage bands remain nonblocking diagnostics because report_76 contains ratios of independent P50s. Raw stats retains every repeat and reports first-repeat separately; first-repeat is not a globally cold measurement because routes share the process/runtime.

bench_aligners_repr_storage.description: Force the 32-bit (K=7 / MEDIUM) and 128-bit (K=27 / XL) MinimizerRepr storage variants. Smaller grid (3 algorithm rows) so the bucket finishes in minutes.

bench_bounded_nthash_xxl_hifi_validation.description: Isolated restart-free XXL_HIFI validation for the bounded u32/R7/sum SIMD sketch. The ExactSimd row is an oracle/debug comparator. Both bounded-ntHash rows must execute bounded ntHash sketch execution stats plus SIMD chaining, and the Block row must additionally execute Block Aligner SIMD; the strict runner requires exactly one primary mapping with target offset strictly below 15 bp. The bounded-ntHash/ExactSimd sketch ratios compare unequal work and are stably 1.46-1.48, so their strict <1.0 faster-than boundary is retained only as a visible nonblocking comparison diagnostic, not acceptance.

bench_aligners_rmq_repro.description: Pinned (LONG, CCS) regression seed covering bioseq-RMQ AVL rebalancing. One row asserts a non-zero match count.
